summary: Include constraints and rejected alternatives in assembled decision output for pattern propagation
context: Benchmark showed full-twining agents interpreting decisions independently, choosing different patterns (EventBus vs CallbackRegistry). shared-markdown agents copied concrete patterns from COORDINATION.md. Twining decisions had constraints and alternatives in the record but dropped them at assembly time.
rationale: Constraints like 'All services must use EventBus.emit()' and rejected alternatives like 'Direct calls: tight coupling' give agents concrete directives about what to do and what not to do. This bridges the gap between abstract decision summaries and actionable implementation guidance.
